args.name: nc
args.inactive_reason: Integer column count of the layer group, fixed by the wrapper.

args.name: nl
args.inactive_reason: Integer layer count of the layer group (64 or 65 on x1.2562), fixed by the wrapper.

args.name: overlap
args.inactive_reason: Integer cloud-overlap selector (cldovrlp; 2 = maximum-random on hrrrv5).

args.name: draws
args.inactive_reason: Integer KISS draws per g-point (mcica_draws_per_gpoint: nl for overlap 1-2).

args.name: abase
args.reads: row 5 (cloud fraction, mask only: zero derivative under the frozen mask), rows 6..8 (liquid, ice, snow: masked copy)
args.derivative_rows: 6, 7, 8 (rows 0..5 and 9..11 have zero derivative; the AD leaves them untouched)

args.name: seeds
args.inactive_reason: Integer KISS state per column from mpas_lw_mcica_seeds; enters only the cloudy decision (frozen mask). These are the saved McICA samples.

args.name: weights
args.inactive_reason: Exponential-overlap weights (overlap >= 4 only; a 1-word dummy otherwise); enter only the comparison cdf2 < alpha (frozen mask).

args.name: xorshift
args.inactive_reason: Host GF(2) jump table (xorshift_jump_table(draws, 140)); integer, fixed per (draws).

args.name: cloud
args.note: 0/1 mask: derivative identically 0 under the frozen mask

saved_note: No tape and no stored mask. The McICA samples are reproduced bitwise from the pre-launch seeds, weights and xorshift words, which the window binds as primal pre-launch copies (harness __check: bitwise to the forward image on every captured launch).

branches.rule: cf has zero derivative everywhere in this kernel (it only feeds the mask), so the flush needs no tangent rule

branches.predicate: overlap chain: cdf2 < alpha / prev > 1 - prevcf
branches.rule: chain choice frozen at the trajectory; cdf only feeds the mask

branches.tie: cdf == 1 - cf is cloudy (forward >=); the derivative there is a Dirac in cf, dropped
branches.rule: mask frozen at the trajectory: d liquid/ice/snow = mask * d abase rows 6/7/8, d cloud = 0

limiters: frozen-coefficient: the 0/1 McICA mask (cdf >= 1 - cf) and the overlap chain choices are frozen at the trajectory; the linearisation is the exact derivative of the real map off the threshold set and drops the cloud-fraction sensitivity (a step) entirely

refusal.domain: cf finite; every written derivative word finite; 1 <= nl <= 140; 1 <= overlap <= 5

precondition: abase, seeds, weights, xorshift, cloud, liquid, ice, snow are distinct allocations (no aliasing). TL: one thread per (c, ig) writes that g-point's words. AD: one thread per (c, k) reads and zeroes all 140 g-point cotangents of layer k and owns b_abase(6..8, k): deterministic, no atomics on data words
precision: TL is a masked copy (bitwise, no arithmetic). AD sums the 140 g-point cotangents per (c, row, k) in double in ascending ig, adds the incoming accumulate word in double, one rounding to f32 (the glue-row rule). The mask comes from the forward's own stream helpers copied verbatim (--fmad=false --ftz=false)
